description: Canonical 14-stage lifecycle catalog. Every System is built by selecting and configuring a subset of these stages. AI tasks listed per stage type are the assists a SystemAdmin may enable.

ai_task_prompts.draft_notification: You draft official public notifications/announcements. Be formal, concise, and complete (dates, eligibility, process).
ai_task_prompts.summarize_announcement: Summarize the announcement into key bullet points an applicant must know.
ai_task_prompts.assist_form_fill: Help the applicant complete their application form. Suggest values and flag missing/inconsistent fields. Never fabricate identity data.
ai_task_prompts.validate_application: Validate the application data for completeness and internal consistency. List issues as a checklist.
ai_task_prompts.classify_document: Classify the uploaded document into a type (id_proof, marksheet, certificate, photo, signature, other) and state confidence.
ai_task_prompts.summarize_document: Summarize the key facts in this document relevant to eligibility (name, dates, marks, authority).
ai_task_prompts.check_completeness: Given the required document list and submitted documents, list which mandatory documents are missing.
ai_task_prompts.assess_eligibility: Assess eligibility STRICTLY against the provided criteria. Return a recommendation (ELIGIBLE / INELIGIBLE / NEEDS_REVIEW) with reasons. You only advise; a human verifier decides.
ai_task_prompts.explain_decision: Explain the given decision in plain, defensible language suitable for an audit trail.
ai_task_prompts.suggest_schedule: Suggest an exam/interview schedule given candidate counts, capacity and constraints.
ai_task_prompts.generate_questions: Generate fair, unbiased assessment questions for the given subject and difficulty.
ai_task_prompts.proctor_summary: Summarize proctoring flags into a concise integrity report.
ai_task_prompts.score_response: Score the candidate response against the rubric. Return a numeric score, justification, and per-criterion breakdown. Be consistent and unbiased.
ai_task_prompts.rubric_feedback: Give constructive rubric-based feedback on the response.
ai_task_prompts.explain_ranking: Explain how the merit rank was derived from scores and tie-breakers.
ai_task_prompts.detect_anomaly: Inspect the ranking/score data for anomalies (duplicates, outliers, suspicious clustering).
ai_task_prompts.recommend_preferences: Given the candidate's rank/score and the available options, recommend a sensible ordered preference list and explain why.
ai_task_prompts.recommend_allocation: Given merit ranks, preferences, capacities and reservation rules, recommend an allocation. Respect capacity and category rules strictly.
ai_task_prompts.explain_allocation: Explain to the applicant why they were allotted (or not allotted) a particular option.
ai_task_prompts.payment_reminder: Draft a polite payment reminder with the amount, purpose and deadline.
ai_task_prompts.cross_check_data: Cross-check application data against verified documents and list mismatches.
ai_task_prompts.onboarding_checklist: Produce a step-by-step onboarding checklist for the enrolled candidate.
ai_task_prompts.welcome_message: Write a warm, professional welcome/onboarding message.
ai_task_prompts.analytics_summary: Summarize the cycle outcomes (counts, fill rate, category-wise stats) into an executive summary.
ai_task_prompts.lessons_learned: List lessons learned and process improvement suggestions for the next cycle.
